title: 2 hours Sunrise at Moraine Lake & 2 hours Lake Louise (everyday)
includes: Fun and expert local guide with lots of local secrets to share!
Blankets for the cool morning weather
Pick-up and drop-off service from Banff, Canmore.
Special access to Banff National Parks & lakes at your convenience.
Booster and car seats for kids under 7 years old. Bring your own child seat. We do not provide them! (not included)
Meals and All personal expenses (not included)
requirements: Suitable for all physical fitness levels
All guests pay the adult rate. Special rate for Children and infants. If you plan to bring a child, please notate (including the age) in the "Special Requirements" box at checkout.
Infant and children under 7 years must come with their own booster seats as we do not provide them.
Please check in with us in advance to confirm whether bringing a stroller is possible.
policies: Special rate for groups and private tours!

Please note that if any attraction is closed on the day of the tour due to weather, safety, or operational conditions, we will do our best to replace it with another stunning destination in the Canadian Rockies. Our goal is to ensure you still enjoy a memorable experience filled with the natural beauty and highlights of the Rockies.
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
- Discover the serene beauty of Banff National Park during the early morning hours on this thoughtfully crafted sunrise tour.
- Begin with a visit to Moraine Lake, where the first light illuminates the breathtaking Valley of the Ten Peaks, offering two hours of tranquility and stunning views. 
- Continue to Lake Louise for another two hours to explore its turquoise waters and majestic surroundings, with optional canoe rentals available for a unique perspective. 
- Spend 2 hours each at Moraine Lake and Lake Louise
- Optional canoe rental available at Lake Louise (seasonal, not included)
- Enjoy a relaxed pace for hiking, exploring, or unwinding at each destination
- Not private, max 14 guests. 
- This tour is seasonal and available only from (June 01 - October 13) 2026 only.
